subject: planner: preference range scan for pseudo (#55633)
summary: Updates skyline pruning to prefer certain non-full-range access paths only when `tidb_opt_prefer_range_scan` is enabled and the table has pseudo stats / is empty, while preserving forced/TiFlash/MV-index paths and accounting for index-merge hints/fixcontrol; also flips the default of `tidb_opt_prefer_range_scan` to ON.
